reviewed_by: Codex review of remaining nebula-v3.0.13 broad real-Core release failures
reason: The failed release's broad real-Core shard reached an authenticated Terminal landing screen without a visible Workbench Core chip, looked for project switching outside the current navigation control, and included managed-browser journeys without staging their prerequisites. Quiet Lens also hid composer settings until hover and covered a provider context button in the desktop journey. The mobile navigation handle intercepted Open conversations after a project switch. Select exact production LAN journeys for pairing, context actions, project switching, settings after reload, managed browser runtime and security proxy, plus the Quiet Lens desktop and 320/390 px Chromium/WebKit navigation journey.
exclusions: Python, frontend unit, and native behavior are unchanged, so those layers have no selected cases. The browser selection is sixteen named cases; unrelated real-Core, provider, and interface suites are excluded. The full suite was not requested.
